|rulings=* The revealed cards may be deployed in any order.<ref name="scomp">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Players Committee card data, Dark Side], “Emergency Deployment” (1_244), commit d4e661ec, “rulings” and “counterpart”. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183206/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json Internet Archive] (20 October 2026).</ref>
* Does not circumvent any deployment rules such as requiring presence or Force icons, [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] rules, etc.
* All cards revealed but not deployed are lost.
* If [[Blizzard 4]] shuffles the Reserve Deck, any remaining revealed cards are un-revealed and shuffled in, ending the action.
* If the player somehow activates or loses Force from Reserve Deck while the top card is revealed, it is un-revealed and then activated/lost normally.
